title: Red Sox fend off Dodgers, 9-4, in grindy series opener
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Ceddanne Rafaela's seventh-inning two-run homer gave the Boston Red Sox a 5-4 lead over the Los Angeles Dodgers.
Brayan Bello pitched four scoreless innings, maintaining his league-best 0.69 ERA in relief, aiding the Red Sox's bullpen.
Boston Red Sox finished July with a franchise-best 21-4 record, winning 9-4 against the Dodgers in their latest game.

title: Gabe Jacas makes his Patriots debut and other takeaways from Day 7 of training camp
author: Conor Ryan
bullets: Gabe Jacas made his limited practice debut for the Patriots after recovering from a knee procedure.
Drake Maye's performance included a strong start but also an interception by safety Dell Pettus.
Undrafted rookie Tanner Arkin earned first-team reps as a blocking tight end, impressing coaches with his physicality.

title: Mass. to be 4th state to roll out EBT chip cards to curb fraud
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Massachusetts is issuing chip-enabled EBT cards statewide to curb benefit theft, following a successful pilot in Worcester.
Nearly 1 million SNAP recipients in Massachusetts will receive updated cards, with the state distributing $2.6 billion annually.
Recipients can lock/unlock EBT cards via an app, and new cards must be used within 60 days of receipt.

title: Boston is now offering ‘pet certificates’ for couples who wed at City Hall
author: Morgan Rousseau
bullets: Boston offers 'pet certificates' for couples wed at City Hall, recognizing pets as part of the union.
Mayor Michelle Wu announced the initiative, providing certificates via the 'City of Boston Department of Cuddles.'
The first certificate was given to Bono the golden retriever, acknowledged as a 'true Pawstonian.'

title: Kevin Nealon discusses Conan, Dunkin’, SNL and more ahead of local shows
author: Lauren Daley
bullets: Kevin Nealon discusses his comedic evolution and tweets ahead of shows in Boston and Portsmouth, N.H.
Nealon reminisces about New England, mentioning his Dunkin' Donuts job and ties to the region.
The comedian highlights his projects, including 'Loose in the Crotch' and 'Hiking with Kevin' on YouTube.

title: Red Sox’ Willson Contreras leaves game after scary HBP vs. Dodgers
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: Red Sox' Willson Contreras hit in the head by a 95 MPH fastball during a game against the Dodgers.
Contreras initially stayed in the game but was later removed for precautionary reasons after being hit.
Manager Chad Tracy reported that Contreras is doing well but will be evaluated further for a possible concussion.

title: After Patriots coaching stint, DeAndre Hopkins joins Georgia Tech staff
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: DeAndre Hopkins joined Georgia Tech as an assistant wide receivers coach after a brief coaching experience with the Patriots.
Hopkins's new position at Georgia Tech links him with offensive coordinator George Godsey and defensive coach Vinnie Sunseri.
Hopkins, 34, has not officially retired from the NFL, but his coaching role prioritizes this career path for now.

title: Could Efton Chism and Kyle Williams both make the Patriots 53-man roster?
author: Colin McCarthy
bullets: Efton Chism and Kyle Williams impress in Patriots training camp, with notable touchdown grabs in the red zone period.
Patriots face a dilemma with seven strong wide receivers for potentially six roster spots, complicating final decisions.
Kayshon Boutte's trade request could impact roster choices, affecting Williams and Chism's chances to make the team.

title: Reports: OF George Springer interested in trade to Red Sox, team eyeing INF Xavier Edwards
author: Kaley Brown
bullets: George Springer, currently with the Blue Jays, is open to a trade to the Boston Red Sox.
The Red Sox are interested in acquiring Miami Marlins infielder Xavier Edwards for his versatility and speed.
Xavier Edwards has a .292 average and 18 stolen bases; he's arbitration-eligible in 2027.

title: 5 must-watch movies & TV shows streaming right now
author: Kevin Slane
bullets: 'The Devil Wears Prada 2' with Anne Hathaway and Meryl Streep is now streaming on Hulu.
'The Drama', a dark comedy with Zendaya and Robert Pattinson, is available on HBO Max.
'Furious' Season 1, a thriller series led by Emmy Rossum, is streaming on Hulu.
